agentCapabilities.name: Select Station
agentCapabilities.description: Pick a station lane matching daypart/context from the real manifest.
gates: station exists in manifest

agentCapabilities.name: Play Track
agentCapabilities.description: Queue a track rights-aware: full only for free-tier/entitled; otherwise 45s preview.
gates: accessState(full|preview) via commerce rules
never plays locked/unpublished-claimed content

agentCapabilities.name: Announce
agentCapabilities.description: Spoken introduction via TTS persona, built ONLY from manifest facts (station, title, version).
gates: text derived from manifest fields only — no fabricated claims
AI disclosure appended
rate-limited (maxAnnouncementsPerHour)

agentCapabilities.name: Recommend
agentCapabilities.description: Suggest catalogue tracks from the same station/version group.
gates: recommendations limited to real catalogue entries

agentCapabilities.name: Suggest Purchase
agentCapabilities.description: Transparent upsell after repeated previews, at real server prices via the existing commerce flow.
gates: only after upsellAfterPreviews previews of the same track
price shown from commerce defaults
checkout via existing /api/payments/order only
disclosed as a suggestion, never auto-purchased

agentCapabilities.name: Weather Brief
agentCapabilities.description: Speak the real weather gate output; silent when the provider is NULL.
gates: only when /api/weather returns status ok — never fabricated

agentCapabilities.name: Insert Ad
gates: BLOCKED: requires rights-verified ad inventory + ENABLE_ADS=1 (none exists)

agentCapabilities.name: Answer Question
agentCapabilities.description: Answer listener questions using ONLY cited sources (content library + knowledge-graph search) via the Phase-2 cognition service.
gates: AGENT_LLM_PROVIDER + key configured, else blocked-llm-provider-null
zero retrieved sources ⇒ exact honest fallback, LLM not called
model output must be valid structured JSON or nothing executes
play/recommend ids validated against manifest + commerce access
provider disclosure appended server-side to every spoken text

agentCapabilities.name: Run Quiz
gates: BLOCKED: quiz content type has no real content yet

agentCapabilities.name: Compose Content
agentCapabilities.description: Generate new music (Suno/Udio/local seam) and lyrics (LLM) — always stored unpublished pending rights closure.
gates: CONTENTGEN_PROVIDER/AGENT_LLM_PROVIDER configured, else blocked-provider-null
admin-gated endpoint only
every output stored published:false with permanent aiGenerated provenance
publication ONLY via verified rights proof (publishGenerated refuses otherwise)

agentPolicy.disclosure: — announcement by the AI Radio Assistant (rule-based).
agentPolicy.llmDisclosure: This announcement was generated by our AI Radio Assistant with help from {provider}.
